name: Books
summary: Your own bookkeeping: accounts, a register, transfers, bills and income reminders, debts and a payoff order, reconciling, and spending by category. Kept on this computer only.
author: The JimmyHQ project

settings.label: How you write amounts
settings.help: Which mark separates the cents. Books reads what you type this way and shows every amount this way.

settings.label: Show bills and income due within (days)
settings.help: Bills and income lists what is overdue and what is due within this many days. The rest is listed under Later.

settings.label: Look ahead (days)
settings.help: How far Ahead projects an account's balance, from today's balance and the bills and income due.

settings.label: Put a card on your Bench when a bill is coming due
settings.help: The card says the bill's name and due date only: never an amount or an account.

settings.label: Days before a bill is due to tell you
settings.help: 0 means on the day it is due.

settings.label: Post reminders marked "This happens by itself"
settings.help: When on, Books puts such a reminder in the register by itself on or after its due date, as Post would, and says so on the Bills and Ahead screens. Off, every reminder waits for you to press Post. A reminder whose amount is only about this much is never posted by itself.

settings.label: Most missed dates posted by themselves at once
settings.help: If Books was not looking for a while, it posts a reminder's missed dates one by one, up to this many, then stops and tells you; the rest are yours to post or skip.

settings.label: Pay debts off in this order
settings.help: Which debt gets the extra money first in the payoff view: the smallest balance first, or the highest rate first. Every debt still gets its minimum.

settings.label: Extra each month for debts
settings.help: What you can pay on top of the minimums each month, written the way you write amounts (see above). The payoff view puts it on the first debt in the order, and when that one is paid, its payment moves on to the next.

settings.label: Rows shown at first in a register
settings.help: The newest rows of an account. Show older rows brings in more. Balances are always worked out from the very first row.

settings.label: Largest file to bring in (MB)
settings.help: The most a CSV file or an Import everything file may hold. A file is sent to Books in pieces, so a big one takes a moment.

settings.label: Look for bills coming due every (minutes)
settings.help: How often Books looks at its own reminders to keep the sidebar count and the Bench cards right. Nothing leaves this computer.
